ledger-reconcile.Description: Double-entry ledger service and end-of-day reconciliation

extract.Job Spec Yaml:
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  generateName: ledger-reconcile-extract-
  namespace: ledger-qa
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ledger
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: berth
    berth.contoso.io/app: ledger
    berth.contoso.io/env: qa
    app.kubernetes.io/component: reconcile-extract
spec:
  backoffLimit: 0
  activeDeadlineSeconds: 1200
  ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 86400
  template:
    metadata:
      namespace: ledger-qa
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: ledger
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: berth
        berth.contoso.io/app: ledger
        berth.contoso.io/env: qa
        app.kubernetes.io/component: reconcile-extract
        app.kubernetes.io/version: "3.1.0"
        azure.workload.identity/use: "true"
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: ledger
      automountServiceAccountToken: true
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 10001
        fsGroup: 10001
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: base
          image: contosoacr.azurecr.io/ledger:3.1.0@sha256:d8fdf1a959463640467b00e3a115d3d72fce9d763bacded29eea43651dd90c72
          command:
            - ledger
            - export
            - --since
            - yesterday
          env:
            - name: BERTH_APP
              value: ledger
            - name: BERTH_ENV
              value: qa
            - name: BERTH_VERSION
              value: "3.1.0"
            - name: SQL_CONNECTION
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: ledger-secrets
                  key: sql-connection
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: ledger-config-e9b643b0f2
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 512Mi
            limits:
              memory: 512Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 10001
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir:
            sizeLimit: 1Gi
      restartPolicy: Never
